items.title: UPS Partners With TikTok Shop for No-Box, No-Label Returns Service
items.summary: UPS (NYSE:UPS) has entered into a partnership with TikTok Shop to provide an exclusive no-box, no-label returns service for participating sellers on the social commerce platform in the United States. The service will be provided through Happy Returns, allowing TikTok Shop customers to return eligible products without packaging or printed shipping labels.

items.title: What Does FedEx (FDX) New Authenticated Delivery Service Mean For High Value Shipments?
items.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) has introduced FedEx Authenticated Delivery, a new premium service focused on secure, digitally verified shipments. The product targets high-value deliveries for sectors such as luxury goods, healthcare, and other sensitive categories. FedEx Authenticated Delivery is designed to reduce fraud, theft, and misdelivery risk through tighter identity and delivery verification. items.title: Is UPS Stock Cheap Because It Chose To Shrink?
items.summary: United Parcel Service (UPS) generates free cash flow worth 6.8% of its market capitalization of about $80.6 billion, well above the 4.4% median for an S&P 500 company. A yield that high means a bargain, or a business the market expects to shrink. UPS is shrinking on purpose. It has cut about 2 million pieces a day of lower-quality Amazon volume, and investors want to see what the smaller network earns.
